summary: One choice inside violet-select, violet-combobox or violet-listbox.

usage.text: The value attribute defaults to the option's text when omitted. Selection is matched by value, so every option under one parent needs a distinct value.
The label attribute replaces the slotted text as the option's text for the select trigger, the combobox input, filtering and type-ahead. The slotted content still renders in the list.
Slots (absent from the manifest): default for the label, before and after for inline content, description for a second line.
It does nothing alone: a click emits an internal request-select event that the parent select, combobox or listbox consumes. Listen for the change event on the parent instead.
